tool_schemas.name: listTasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks in the workspace and returns a cursor-paged result set honoring the provided filters (project/section/parent, status, due/created ranges) and sort options; the response contains up to `limit` items and a `cursor` you can pass to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id does not match its required pattern, if date-time filters are not valid ISO-8601 timestamps, or if `limit` is outside 1–200. Raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id`, `section_id`, or `parent_task_id` is provided but does not exist (or does not belong to this workspace), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the referenced container.

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent task id (subtasks of this task).

due_before.description: Return tasks with due_at strictly before this timestamp.

due_after.description: Return tasks with due_at strictly after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Return tasks created strictly before this timestamp.

created_after.description: Return tasks created strictly after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getTask
tool_schemas.description: Returns the task identified by `task_id` including its current fields and status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is missing or does not match the required id pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist (or is not accessible in this workspace), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view it.

tool_schemas.name: createTask
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task in the given `project_id` (optionally in `section_id` or under `parent_task_id`) and returns the created task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, ids do not match their patterns, `priority` is not 1–4, or due fields are invalid (including providing an invalid timestamp/date format). Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced project/section/parent task does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if you attempt to place the task into a section or parent task that is not within the specified project.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

section_id.description: Section id the task belongs to.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id to create this task as a subtask.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for interpreting due_at/due_date.

tool_schemas.name: updateTask
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on the specified task (including moves between project/section/parent, due/priority/order changes, and status changes) and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` or any provided ids are malformed, if `priority` is not 1–4, if due fields are not valid formats, or if `status` is not one of `active|completed|deleted`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task or any newly referenced project/section/parent task does not exist or is not accessible, CONFLICT if the requested move/re-parent would place the task under a parent/section that does not belong to the target project, or if the update requests an unsupported state transition (for example setting an already-deleted task back to `active`).

project_id.description: Move task to a different project id.

section_id.description: Move task to a different section id.

parent_task_id.description: Re-parent task under a different parent task id.

due_date.description: Updated due date (date-only string, e.g. YYYY-MM-DD).

timezone.description: Updated IANA timezone name for interpreting due_at/due_date.

order_index.description: Updated ordering hint within the container (project/section).

is_recurring.description: Update whether the task is recurring.

tool_schemas.name: completeTask
tool_schemas.description: Marks the task as completed and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is missing or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the task is already completed or is deleted and cannot be completed.

task_id.description: The task id to mark as completed.

tool_schemas.name: reopenTask
tool_schemas.description: Reopens a completed task (sets it back to active) and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is missing or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the task is already active or is deleted and cannot be reopened.

task_id.description: The task id to reopen (mark as active).

tool_schemas.name: deleteTask
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified task (sets its status to `deleted`) and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is missing or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the task is already deleted.

tool_schemas.name: listProjects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in the workspace and returns a cursor-paged result set honoring the provided filters (parent, status, favorite, inbox, view style) and sort options; the response contains up to `limit` items and a `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `parent_project_id` is malformed or if `limit` is outside 1–200. Raises NOT_FOUND if `parent_project_id` is provided but does not exist (or is not accessible), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list projects in this workspace.

parent_project_id.description: Filter projects by parent project id (sub-projects of this project).

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getProject
tool_schemas.description: Returns the project identified by `project_id`, optionally allowing archived and/or deleted projects to be returned when `include_archived`/`include_deleted` is set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is missing or does not match the required id pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, or if it is archived/deleted and the corresponding include flag is not enabled, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access it.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to retrieve (e.g., tdp_prj_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

include_archived.description: Whether archived projects may be returned.

include_deleted.description: Whether deleted projects may be returned.

tool_schemas.name: createProject
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project (optionally under `parent_project_id`) and returns the created project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is missing/invalid, if `color` or `view_style` is not one of the supported values, or if `parent_project_id` is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if `parent_project_id` is provided but does not exist (or is not accessible), and CONFLICT if the requested parent is not eligible to have children (for example, if it is deleted).

parent_project_id.description: Parent project ID to create this project under.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

view_style.description: Preferred view style for the project.

tool_schemas.name: updateProject
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing project’s mutable fields (name, color, parent_project_id, order_index, is_favorite, view_style, status) and returns the updated project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any field is invalid (including unknown enum values or a malformed ID), NOT_FOUND if project_id (or parent_project_id when provided) does not exist, and CONFLICT if the update would create an invalid hierarchy (for example moving a project under itself/its descendant) or attempts a refused status transition.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to update.

parent_project_id.description: Parent project ID to move this project under.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

view_style.description: Preferred view style for the project.

tool_schemas.name: archiveProject
tool_schemas.description: Archives the specified project (sets its status to archived) and returns the updated project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, and CONFLICT if the project is already archived or is deleted and cannot be archived.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to archive.

tool_schemas.name: unarchiveProject
tool_schemas.description: Unarchives the specified project (sets its status to active) and returns the updated project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, and CONFLICT if the project is not archived (for example already active) or is deleted and cannot be unarchived.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to unarchive.

tool_schemas.name: deleteProject
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified project (sets its status to deleted) and returns the updated project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, and CONFLICT if the project is already deleted.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to delete.

tool_schemas.name: getProjectCollaborators
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of collaborators for the given project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist.

project_id.description: The ID of the project whose collaborators should be returned.

tool_schemas.name: listSections
tool_schemas.description: Lists sections that belong to a project and returns a page of results sorted by sort_by/sort_order, along with a next cursor when more results are available (omit cursor to fetch the first page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, limit is out of range, or any enum parameter is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist.

project_id.description: Return sections belonging to this project.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getSection
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single section by section_id and returns the section. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if section_id is malformed and NOT_FOUND if the section does not exist.

section_id.description: The ID of the section to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: createSection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new section in the specified project and returns the created section. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, name is missing/invalid, or order_index is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the new section belongs to.

order_index.description: Sort position of the section within the project.

tool_schemas.name: updateSection
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing section’s fields (name, order_index, status) and returns the updated section. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if section_id is malformed or any provided field is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the section does not exist, and CONFLICT if the requested status transition is refused (for example updating a section that is already deleted).

section_id.description: The ID of the section to update.

order_index.description: New sort position of the section within the project.

tool_schemas.name: deleteSection
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a section (sets status to deleted) and returns the updated section. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if section_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the section does not exist, and CONFLICT if the section is already deleted.

section_id.description: The ID of the section to delete.

tool_schemas.name: listComments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments visible in the current workspace, optionally filtered by task_id and/or project_id and by status, returning up to limit results sorted by sort and order; responses are paged using the opaque cursor, which you pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filter/sort values are invalid or limit is out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or cannot access the referenced task/project. Raises NOT_FOUND when a provided task_id or project_id does not exist (or is not accessible to the caller).

task_id.description: Filter comments to those belonging to a task.

project_id.description: Filter comments to those belonging to a project.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getComment
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single comment by comment_id and returns the full comment record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if comment_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or cannot access the comment. Raises NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist (or is not accessible in the current workspace).

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: createComment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment with the given content and optional attachment, attached to either a task (task_id) or a project (project_id), and returns the created comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if content is missing/invalid, if both task_id and project_id are provided or neither is provided, or if IDs are malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or cannot comment on the target. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced task or project does not exist (or is not accessible).

task_id.description: The ID of the task to attach the comment to.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to attach the comment to.

attachment.description: Optional attachment payload stored on the comment.

tool_schemas.name: updateComment
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing comment’s content, attachment, and/or status and returns the updated comment; setting status to deleted performs a soft-delete. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid status values, or an empty update request, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or lacks permission to modify the comment. Raises NOT_FOUND if comment_id does not exist (or is not accessible).

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to update.

tool_schemas.name: deleteComment
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a comment by comment_id and returns the deleted comment (with status set to deleted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if comment_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated or lacks permission to delete the comment. Raises NOT_FOUND if the comment does not exist (or is not accessible).

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

tool_schemas.name: listLabels
tool_schemas.description: Lists labels in the current workspace, optionally filtered by status, is_favorite, and color, returning up to limit results sorted by sort and sort_order; results are paged using the opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters/sort values are invalid or limit is out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated. Returns an empty page when no labels match the filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: getLabel
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single label by label_id and returns the label record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist (or is not accessible in the current workspace).

label_id.description: ID of the label to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: createLabel
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new label with the given name and optional color, order_index, and is_favorite, returning the created label. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/invalid or color is not one of the supported values, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated. Raises CONFLICT if a label with the same name already exists in the workspace.

order_index.description: Sort/order position of the label among other labels.

is_favorite.description: Whether the label is marked as a favorite.

tool_schemas.name: updateLabel
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing label’s name, color, order_index, and/or is_favorite and returns the updated label. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid color values, or an empty update request, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated. Raises NOT_FOUND if label_id does not exist (or is not accessible) and CONFLICT if renaming would duplicate an existing label name in the workspace.

label_id.description: ID of the label to update.

order_index.description: Updated sort/order position of the label.

is_favorite.description: Updated favorite flag for the label.

tool_schemas.name: deleteLabel
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a label by label_id and returns the deleted label (with status set to deleted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist (or is not accessible); tasks may retain historical references but the label will no longer be active.

label_id.description: ID of the label to delete.

tool_schemas.name: getSharedLabels
tool_schemas.description: Lists the shared-label mappings for the specified label_id and returns a paged collection of entries; use limit to cap results (1–200) and cursor to fetch the next page when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed, limit is out of range, or cursor is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the label_id does not exist or is not accessible in the current workspace/account. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to view the label’s sharing settings, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

label_id.description: ID of the label whose shared-label mappings should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of shared-label entries to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: renameSharedLabel
tool_schemas.description: Renames the underlying label identified by label_id and returns the updated label as it will appear across all shared uses. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id is malformed or name is missing/invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist or is not accessible in the current workspace/account. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to edit the label, CONFLICT if the rename would violate label naming constraints (for example, a duplicate name in the same scope), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

label_id.description: ID of the underlying label to rename for all shared uses.

name.description: New name to apply to the shared label.

tool_schemas.name: removeSharedLabel
tool_schemas.description: Removes a specific sharing relationship for the label_id and shared_with identifier and returns the updated sharing state for that label (with the specified mapping removed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label_id/shared_with are malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the label does not exist or is not accessible, or if there is no shared-label mapping for that (label_id, shared_with) pair. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to manage label sharing, CONFLICT if the mapping cannot be removed due to the current collaboration state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

label_id.description: ID of the label to stop sharing.

shared_with.description: Identifier of the collaborator/account the label was shared with (as stored in labels.shared_labels).

metadata.name: Todoist Task and Project Manager
metadata.description: This backend stores Todoist-like projects, sections, tasks, comments, and labels for a single account/workspace, including collaboration and label sharing. Main workflows include CRUD over projects/sections/tasks/comments/labels, task state changes (complete/reopen), project archiving, and managing
